name: @jdf/demo-video-rag
description: Demo video: a video inside a JDF document becomes searchable — jdf transcribe, time-windowed chunks with media.t0/t1, viewer.seek, jdf rag over a folder.

scripts.render: tsx scripts/prepare.ts && tsx scripts/fetch-music.ts && remotion render src/index.ts VideoRag out/video-rag.mp4 --crf 16 && cp out/video-rag.mp4 video-rag.mp4
